top_signals.title: Bank of England Holds Interest Rates at 3.75%
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England kept interest rates unchanged at 3.75% while warning that a hike may be needed if inflationary pressures intensify as a result of conflict in the Middle East. Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz and Jonathan Ferro react to the breaking news. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Correspondence: Open letters between HM Treasury and Bank of England, September 2026
top_signals.summary: CPI inflation was 3.1% in August 2026, prompting an open letter from the Governor of the Bank of England to the Chancellor on 17 September 2026. The Chancellor replied to the Governor on 17 September 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
